```yaml
name: Draft Release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version to release (optional, auto-detected if not provided)'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (codex, glm, kimi) to use for release'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  draft_release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check actor permissions
        if: github.actor != 'dyoshikawa' && github.actor != 'cm-dyoshikawa'
        run: |
          echo "Error: Only dyoshikawa or cm-dyoshikawa can trigger this workflow"
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Select OpenCode Model
        id: select_model
        uses: ./actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" ]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            # Auto-detect version using release-dry-run logic
            echo "version=0.0.0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create release branch and PR
        run: |
          # Implementation would create release branch and PR
          echo "Creating release branch and PR for version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          echo "Using model: ${{ steps.select_model.outputs.cleaned-text }}"

      - name: Create draft release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          release_name: Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          body: |
            ## Release Notes
            
            This is a draft release for version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}.
            
            ### Model Used
            ${{ steps.select_model.outputs.cleaned-text }}
            
            ### Changelog
            <!-- Changelog will be populated automatically -->
```
